text: twist the hemp fibre by hand into a stout rope and coat it with the pine pitch
reason: You twist the hemp fibres together by hand into a rope. It will hold light loads, but hand-twisted fibre alone is not stout rope. You work the pine pitch over the rope, coating its fibres in a sticky, water-resistant layer.

text: give the new tarred rope to Gorm for his ferry
reason: You hand the pitched hemp rope to Gorm.
